# Member-function matrix

Which member functions each type answers. The page is generated from the same `//kavun:member`
directives the types' `Methods` tables are generated from, so it cannot disagree with them.
It answers existence only — each type's page carries the contracts.

`✓` = the type answers the member; `—` = no member-call form on that type (a free builtin or an operator of
the same meaning may still exist). `record` has no member surface by design (free builtins only), the callable
kinds have only the universal members, and a `module`'s members are built per module at run time, so none of
them is a column.

Every `✓` member is also readable as a value: `x.name` without a call answers a bound member of `x`
([member functions are values](../types.md#member-functions-are-values)).
